svg.text: mini-JEPA: a world model in embedding space
It predicts the next frames' patch embeddings from the actions, never their pixels.
Predictor (4 blocks): one timestep = an action token + the frame's patches
the action token: 4 actions; then 64 patch tokens
Each patch token predicts that patch's embedding
latent_tf: each step from the real frames
predictor, all timesteps in one pass
latent_ar: the first frame only, fed back
target_std: the targets' spread over the batch; near 0 means collapse.
latent_copy: the error of predicting no change; the model should beat it.
A separate mini-FM, trained alongside, is the policy the sim runs.
